title: Kontext gets a new route to larger images
summary:
Kontext gained a BPAIGen-first image route, larger output settings and a new guidance control, while two text aliases changed backends.

The existing `kontext` model now tries BPAIGen first and falls back to Kontext if that fails. Its configured maximum side length increased from 640 to 1216 pixels, while the `?model=kontext` name and Seed tier requirement stay the same.

Image requests gained an optional `guidance_scale` parameter and report which service is generating the image. Invalid seeds now fall back to 42; `gptimage` was removed from the image model list.

The `openai` alias now maps to `gpt-4.1-nano-roblox`, and `openai-large` maps to `azure-gpt-4.1`. Both previously mapped to `gpt-4o-mini`.

highlights.title: Kontext tries a new route
highlights.text: Generate images with `kontext` using a BPAIGen-first route that falls back to Kontext. Its configured maximum side length is now 1216 pixels. [Explore Kontext](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).

highlights.title: Adjust image guidance
highlights.text: Image requests now accept an optional `guidance_scale` parameter for more control over generation. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Text aliases change models
highlights.text: `openai` now maps to `gpt-4.1-nano-roblox`, while `openai-large` maps to `azure-gpt-4.1`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
